title: Abandoned Shed
text: instrumental background loop for Abandoned Shed: A rickety shed leans precariously at the edge of Willowbrook, its weathered boards creaking in the wind, no vocals

title: Blacksmith's Forge
text: instrumental background loop for Blacksmith's Forge: A hot, smoky forge. A log fire burns on the hearthstone, and not all of its smoke finds the chimney. A single horseshoe hangs on the wall, no vocals

title: Chicken Coop
text: instrumental background loop for Chicken Coop: A small wooden coop stands here, its planks patched and weathered. Nervous chickens cluck and flutter, their feathers ruffled as they dart between straw nests, no vocals

title: Elior's Cottage
text: instrumental background loop for Elior's Cottage: A modest cottage with a straw roof and a cozy hearth. The scent of fresh bread and old books fills the air. The doorway to your room stands open, and the room beyond it is too dark to see into, no vocals

title: Forest Path
text: instrumental background loop for Forest Path: A winding path snakes into the heart of the woods, dappled sunlight flickering through the canopy above. Beside the path, thick, thorny vines block a small alcove, no vocals

title: General Store
text: instrumental background loop for General Store: A cluttered shop with the shutters half down. Rope, apples and trinkets crowd the shelves in the gloom. Hemlock stands at the window, watching the lane to the chapel, no vocals

title: Hidden Glade
text: instrumental background loop for Hidden Glade: A hushed clearing hidden deep within the forest, dim and overgrown. Brambles crowd its edges, and the tall grass stands grey and still beneath branches that shut out the sun, no vocals

title: Mira's Hut
text: instrumental background loop for Mira's Hut: A small hut hung with drying herbs: lavender, sage, and roots in bundles from the rafters. Shelves of bottles line the walls, every one labelled, no vocals

title: Old Mill
text: instrumental background loop for Old Mill: A creaky windmill towers above, its sails turning slowly in the breeze. In the yard below, sacks of grain slump against a stone wall beside a heavy millstone, and the scent of flour hangs in the air, no vocals

title: Riverbank
text: instrumental background loop for Riverbank: A gentle river flows past the village and makes a slow bend here, past the reeds and a broad, flat stone at the water's edge. Insects hum over the water, no vocals

title: Road to Greendale
text: instrumental background loop for Road to Greendale: The main road out of Willowbrook runs east under old oaks, their branches meeting overhead. The way is well trodden, lined with wildflowers and fallen leaves, no vocals

title: The Dream
text: instrumental background loop for The Dream: It is raining hard on a village street. Thunder breaks so close that the shutters shake with it. Shadows drift through the rain like smoke, no vocals

title: Vegetable Field
text: instrumental background loop for Vegetable Field: Rows of withered crops stretch beneath the last grey of the night's storm. The earth is cracked and dry, with only a few stubborn carrots and a rusty trowel hinting at better days, no vocals

title: Village Chapel
text: instrumental background loop for Village Chapel: A small stone chapel at the end of the village lane. Its stained glass windows cast colours across the worn pews, and the air is cool and smells of candle wax. A kindly priest tends the altar, no vocals

title: Village Square
text: instrumental background loop for Village Square: The heart of Willowbrook: cobblestones around an old stone fountain, and a weathered notice board covered in faded announcements, no vocals

title: Village Well
